about.title: About Us
about.historyBody: Damarewadi Charitable Trust was formed in 2026 by members of the community, brought together by a shared wish to look after Damarewadi and the people connected to it — starting with the rebuilding of the village temple. We're a young trust, and this page will grow as our work does.
about.missionBody: To serve the Damarewadi community with honesty and dedication, preserving its heritage and improving the lives of the people who call it home.
about.visionBody: A Damarewadi where community spaces are cared for, community members are supported, and future generations inherit something worth protecting.
about.objectivesBody: To restore and maintain shared community spaces, support residents in need, and keep the community informed and involved in the trust's work.

templeRebuild.title: Rebuilding Our Village Temple
templeRebuild.summary: Our small temple, tucked away from the main settlement, has been badly worn down by heavy monsoon rains. We're working to rebuild it for the people who continue to care for it.
templeRebuild.body:
Our village has a small temple that sits a little apart from where most people live. Over the years, especially after this year's heavy monsoon rains, its structure has suffered — what stands today is little more than a simple stone shelter open to the elements.

Despite the distance and the damage, the handful of families living nearby have kept the tradition of worship alive here, tending to it as best they can with what little support they have.

Damarewadi Charitable Trust has taken up the cause of rebuilding this temple — giving it a proper structure that can withstand the rains and serve the community for years to come. This page will be updated with our progress, photos, and how you can help as the project moves forward.
